# 2544. Alternating Digit Sum

## Solution 1 (time O(logn), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def alternateDigitSum(self, n):
        """
        :type n: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans = 0
        sign = 1
        while n > 0:
            ans += sign * (n % 10)
            sign = -sign
            n /= 10
        return -sign * ans
```
